name: @agent-core/agent-identity-capabilities
description: Agent Identity read-only Broker capability providers (DSH_AGENT_CORE_MODULARITY_PHASE_A_V1): Principal -> Agent resolution, Agent -> Principal reverse resolution, and the Agent Directory — the business implementations behind the agentPrincipalResolutionAccess / agentPrincipalReverseResolutionAccess / agentDirectoryAccess LOCAL capability services.
